source_anchor: Section 6.1, Table 2, Appendix H.2 of arXiv:2606.02047v1
exact_contract: At n=500 samples per each of four regions (N=2000), alpha=0.5, T=200, and 100 independent trials, CDOT has mean barycentric matching MSE 0.0016 and is lower than FGW 0.0034 and IsoRank 0.0033.
primary_acceptance: All exact scale/protocol gates pass and both paired two-sided 95% t-interval upper endpoints for CDOT-minus-baseline are below zero.
exact_value_policy: Ordering evidence and agreement with the displayed point estimates are reported separately.
